verdict.rationale: Rive documents a text-based Rive Markup Language (RML/XML) that lets developers create and modify .riv content as code outside the Editor, and open-sources its runtime libraries for loading/using files across platforms — both support portability and outside-editor tooling. However, community evidence notes the OSS runtime is only a rendering-layer subset and that authoring generally still requires the proprietary Editor, and no full open specification/schema for the .riv binary format itself is provided. Missing for 10: a fully published open .riv file format spec, independent third-party tools that read/write .riv without Rive's own runtime/editor, and confirmation RML covers 100% of file features.
